title: Garden
description: C7 (draft): the garden: typed facts about the owner's life with a valid-time and a transaction-time axis, provenance and expiry. `search` (active tier) returns full facts with ids, optionally `as_of` a past time; `pointers` (passive tier) returns at most three one-line pointers to fact ids and never fact text; `propose` hands a candidate to the edge, which accepts it on its own or queues contradictions and doubts for the owner (`digest`, `resolve`). Secrets enter only as a vault reference. A miss is reported as C1 `garden_miss`. The daemon `ulei-garden serve` serves the operations in `x-methods`: each is `POST /v1/<name>` with the input as the JSON body over HTTP/1.1 on a unix socket, one request per connection; a `200` answer carries the output and any other status carries `Error` (`x-transport`, `x-error`, ADR-0047).

x-transport.protocol: HTTP/1.1 with JSON bodies over a SOCK_STREAM unix socket of at most 107 bytes, mode 0600, in a directory of the daemon's uid that no other user can enter; the daemon listens, any local caller connects
x-transport.request: `POST /v1/<name>` for each `x-methods` entry with the method input as the body
x-transport.response: `200` with the method output as the body; every other status with `Error` as the body
x-transport.connection: one request per connection; every read and write of a connection has a 5 s deadline
x-transport.peer_check: the daemon answers `403 forbidden` and closes a connection whose SO_PEERCRED uid differs from its own uid

as_of.description: Answer as of this Unix time.

private.description: Include private facts (only for the owner's own runtime).

Fact.description: A fact with its validity interval.

valid_to.description: Valid until (Unix time); absent = still valid.

fact_id.description: Id of this fact version; pass it to pointers, digests and resolutions.

domain.description: Domain slug of the fact, if any.

expires_at.description: After this Unix time the fact is stale and must be re-checked; absent = no expiry.

pinned.description: In the pinned core profile (`ProposeRequest.pin`); absent = not pinned.

proof_count.description: 1 plus the `duplicate` proposals that named this fact.

recheck_before_acting.description: The fact's lifetime kind (`law`) must be re-checked before acting on it; absent = false.

lexical_only.description: True when the dense side is down and the facts come from the lexical side alone; absent = false.

ProposeRequest.description: Propose a fact to the edge for reconciliation.

entity.description: Entity id, or a name or alias of an existing entity; an unknown one creates an entity of `kind`.

attribute.description: Single-valued attribute the fact sets (e.g. `address`); a newer value closes the old one, an unsettled one goes to the digest.

valid_to.description: Valid until (Unix time); absent = still valid.

observed_at.description: When the source was observed (Unix time); absent = now.

confidence.description: Proposer's confidence in [0, 1]; below the garden's threshold the candidate goes to the digest. Absent = 1.

secret_ref.description: Vault reference of a secret the fact points to: `vault:` and a path without whitespace; the fact text must not contain the secret value.

private.description: Visible only to the owner's own runtime.

pin.description: Owner only: `true` pins the fact into the core profile, `false` unpins the current fact of the same entity and attribute; a pin change is an update, never a `duplicate`. From any other `source_kind`, or with `secret_ref`, the candidate is `invalid`. Absent: a version that closes a pinned version of the same entity and attribute inherits the pin.

fact_id.description: Id of the fact written (`accepted`) or of the equal fact already held (`duplicate`).

conflicts_with.description: Id of the current fact a queued contradiction conflicts with.

ProposalReason.description: Why a proposal was queued or rejected; `ambiguous_entity`: queued because the candidate's entity name could name more than one entity.

SourceKind.description: Kind of source; rank for reconciliation: owner > raw > internet > agent.

TtlKind.description: Type of a fact for its lifetime (the garden's TTL table, ADR-0044): `weather` 3 h; `never_cache` (open now, live arrivals) is never stored; `fx_rate`, `duty_pharmacy`, `news` 1 day; `price`, `availability`, `timetable` 7 days; `opening_hours`, `contacts` 30 days; `product` 60 days; `law` 90 days and re-checked before acting; `place` (existence, address of an institution) 180 days; `general` and `personal` never expire. Absent = `personal` for owner and raw sources, `general` otherwise.

PointersRequest.description: Passive tier: pointers for a request, without fact text.

k.description: At most this many pointers; default 3.

as_of.description: Answer as of this Unix time.

private.description: Include private facts (only for the owner's own runtime).

Pointer.description: A one-line pointer to a fact: says that a fact exists, not what it says.

fact_id.description: Fact id; `search` or a later lookup returns the text.

entity.description: Name of the entity the fact is about.

hint.description: One line such as `there is a fact about <entity> (<kind>)`; never fact text.

PointersResponse.description: Pointers above the garden's score threshold, best first; empty on a miss.

lexical_only.description: True when the dense side is down and the pointers come from the lexical side alone; absent = false.

DigestReason.description: Why a candidate waits for the owner; `ambiguous_entity`: the candidate's entity name could name any of the item's `entity_candidates`.

DigestRequest.description: List the open digest items, oldest first.

DigestItem.description: A candidate the edge did not accept on its own.

conflicts_with.description: Id of the current fact a contradiction conflicts with.

conflicting_fact.description: Text of that fact, for the owner.

queued_at.description: When the candidate was queued (Unix time).

entity_candidates.description: For `ambiguous_entity`: the existing entities the candidate's name could name; the owner picks one with `ResolveRequest.entity`.

ResolveAction.description: Owner's decision on a digest item: `accept` writes the candidate (closing a conflicting fact), `reject` drops it, `replace` writes `replacement` instead.

proposal_id.description: Proposal id of the digest item.

entity.description: For `accept` of an `ambiguous_entity` item: the chosen entity id, one of the item's `entity_candidates`.

EntityCandidate.description: An existing entity an ambiguous name could name.

DenseState.description: The dense side: `off` without the embedder, `ready`, or `down` while the embedder helper is restarted.

Health.description: The daemon's state for the operator and `ulei status`.

dense_error.description: Why the dense side is down; present only while `dense` is `down`.

failed_proposes.description: Proposes rolled back by a store failure since the daemon started.

unpublished_misses.description: Rows waiting in the miss outbox.

ErrorCode.description: Error class; its HTTP status: `invalid_request` 400 (the body is not the method input), `forbidden` 403, `unknown_method` 404, `not_found` 404 (a `resolve` of an unknown or closed item), `replacement_refused` 409, `too_large` 413, `store_failed` 500.
